notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Like Lord Darydikilkil, we came back from the dead with a small update. 
7 epic success have been added, and we improved the camera angle, for a more comfortable 3rd person mode.

A few minor bugs have also been corrected.

Have fun (and a merry Xmas)!

notes.title: Oculus version completely fixed! (up)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, good news! Following your feedbacks, we have fixed every cameras in every scene in the Oculus version, so the game can be played comfortably now. 

Please keep letting us know of similar matters so we can keep on improving the game.

Infiniverse team
